description: Shared section/hash vectors. Each section text runs from its heading to the next heading of the same or higher level, or EOF; start/end are UTF-16 offsets into document; hash is fnv1a32 over the UTF-8 bytes of that text; key is the heading text normalized for matching (whitespace runs to one space, trimmed, lower case). Expected values computed independently (Python). Read by the web tests and the Go host tests.

notes.description: The same rules with notes in the document: each section lists the ranges its hash leaves out (a note and the gap before it), and text is what is hashed. A comment in a code fence is not a note. textWithoutNotes is the document before its notes were added; the sections of the two hash the same.
